summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Ella Tambussi Grasso, an American Democratic politician who served as the 83rd Governor of Connecticut. It covers her dates of birth and death, her term in office, and two notable firsts: being the first woman elected Governor of Connecticut and the first woman elected governor of any U.S. state without being the spouse or widow of a former governor. It also notes that she resigned due to ovarian cancer.
one_line: Ella Grasso was a Democratic politician who served as the 83rd Governor of Connecticut from 1975 to 1980.
key_facts: Ella Tambussi Grasso was born on May 10, 1919.
Ella Tambussi Grasso died on February 5, 1981.
Ella Tambussi Grasso was an American politician and member of the Democratic Party.
Ella Grasso served as the 83rd Governor of Connecticut.
Ella Grasso's term as Governor of Connecticut began on January 8, 1975.
Ella Grasso's term as Governor of Connecticut ended on December 31, 1980.
Ella Grasso was the first woman elected Governor of Connecticut.
Ella Grasso was the first woman elected governor of a U.S. state without having been the spouse or widow of a former governor.
Ella Grasso resigned as Governor due to her battle with ovarian cancer.
